这是一个非常简单的 ComfyUI 初学者友好的图像到图像工作流程，它将与具有多个 LORA 的单个 QWEN Image GGUF 模型一起使用（此工作流程确实需要 ComfyUI 的 LORA Manager 插件才能运行。最好安装 ComfyUI 管理器和 LORA Manager 插件，以帮助您轻松下载和管理检查点、LORA 和其他资源。这两个不仅对此工作流程有帮助，而且在任何其他情况下都会为您提供很多帮助）。您需要一个 Hugging Face 帐户来下载必要的 QWEN 图像文件（详细信息如下）。确保使用 ComfyUI 管理器为 ComfyUI 安装 GGUF 插件，并将正确的文件放置在正确的位置。另请查看我的 SD 1.5 + SDXL 1.0、WAN 2.1、HiDream 和 通量。

如何使用这个 -

#1.只需选择图像到图像的输入图像

#2.接下来先选择您想要的QWEN Image GGUF模型，然后加载

＃3。从 LORA Manager 启动一个或多个匹配的 LORA

＃4。然后输入你的正面和负面提示。

＃5。选择您想要的图像数量（更改“运行”按钮旁边的数字）

＃6。选择图像采样方法、CFG、步骤等设置

#7.最后按运行按钮生成。就是这样..

*** 如果您知道如何正确禁用 LORA 节点并绕过它，此工作流程也将起作用。

享受吧！

### 要使用此工作流程，您需要登录 Huggingface 并从那里下载必要的文件（我还在包含工作流程文件的存档中包含了一个文本文件，您可以在其中找到更多关于我的其他工作流程的基本下载的链接）-

o.en:
This is a very simple ComfyUI beginner friendly Image-to-Image workflow that will work with a single QWEN Image GGUF model with multiple LORAs (This workflow does require ComfyUI's LORA Manager plugin to function. It is a good idea to install both ComfyUI manager and LORA Manager plugin to help you easily download and manage Checkpoints, LORAs and other resources. Not only these two are helpful for this workflow but they will help you a lot in any other cases). You need a Hugging Face account to download your necessary QWEN Image files (Details are mentioned below). Make sure you install GGUF addon for ComfyUI using ComfyUI manager and place the correct files in correct places. Also check out my other workflows for SD 1.5 + SDXL 1.0, WAN 2.1, HiDream and Flux.

How to use this -

#1. Just select your input image for Image-to-Image

#2. next select your desired QWEN Image GGUF model first and then load

#3. one or multiple matching LORA(s) from LORA Manager to start

#4. then input your positive and negative prompts.

#5. select how many images you want (Change the number besides the "Run" button)

#6. select image sampling methods, CFG, steps etc. settings

#7. finally press the run button to generate. That's it..

*** This workflow will also function if you know how to properly disable the LORA Node and bypass it.

Enjoy!

### To use this workflow you need to log into huggingface and download necessary files from there (I also included a text file on the archive that has the workflow file, in which you will find even more links for essential downloads for my other workflows) -
